featured_reviews.name: Viraj Gaikwad
featured_reviews.review_text: Wide variety of Hot Wheels models, including some rare finds. The store is well-organized and the staff is helpful and friendly. A great spot for any car enthusiast!

featured_reviews.name: Pehlaj sachin
featured_reviews.review_text:
Joybox Gifts and Toys is an amazing place for anyone who loves collectible cars like Hot Wheels, Matchbox, and Majorette. The store has a fantastic variety, making it easy to find both common models and rare gems. Whether you're just starting your collection or already a big collector, there’s always something exciting to discover.

One of the best things about Joybox is how well everything is organized. The cars are displayed neatly, so you can browse comfortably and actually enjoy looking through the collection. The quality of the products is excellent, with all items in great condition, which is really important for collectors.

The staff is also very friendly and helpful. They understand what collectors are looking for and are always ready to assist or suggest something new. It makes the whole shopping experience even better.

Overall, Joybox Gifts and Toys is a must-visit for die-cast car lovers. Great selection, good quality, and a welcoming atmosphere make it a top choice for Hot Wheels, Matchbox, and Majorette fans!

featured_reviews.name: Om Patadiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Joy Box Toys delivers an outstanding experience for both kids and parents. The quality of the toys is impressive—durable, safe, and designed with great attention to detail. Each product feels premium and thoughtfully made, which is rare at this price point.

What truly stands out is the creativity and engagement factor. The toys are not just for fun—they encourage learning, imagination, and skill development. Whether it’s puzzles, activity kits, or interactive toys, they keep children entertained for hours while also being educational.

The packaging is another highlight—colorful, attractive, and perfect for gifting. It gives a “premium unboxing” feel that kids absolutely love.

Thankyou

featured_reviews.name: Debaditya Sengupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Lots and lots of collection you will love. Best part is the owner is very friendly and polite that you will not leave without buying something.
Ps: If you are into Hotwheels, this is one of your go to place to check out atleast once

featured_reviews.name: Jegan Somu
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to sincerely thank Joybox and the owner Sukhdev Nishad for being an incredible support in building my 1:64 scale Red Ferrari collection.

Almost all of the Red Ferraris I currently own have been sourced from Joybox, and the experience has been consistently exceptional. What truly stands out is the personal touch — Sukhdev remembered my interest in Ferraris and would proactively inform me whenever new Ferrari stock arrived. That level of attentiveness is rare and deeply appreciated by collectors like me.

The packaging and shipping to Hyderabad were handled with ultimate care. Every model arrived in pristine condition, which is extremely important for serious collectors.

If you’re a diecast enthusiast looking for reliability, passion, and genuine customer care, Joybox is highly recommended. Thank you for helping me build my dream Ferrari lineup!

featured_reviews.name: Adrian Lopez
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent, unique and rare collection and toys. Great place for collectors.

featured_reviews.name: VIRAJ SHETTY
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely love this gift and toy shop! 🎁🧸 Every time I walk in, I find something unique and delightful — whether it's for a birthday, holiday, or just a little surprise for someone special. The selection is incredible, with toys for all ages, fun games, adorable plushies, and beautifully crafted gifts.

The staff is always friendly, helpful, and full of great suggestions when I’m not sure what to pick. It’s clear they care about quality and customer experience. The shop itself is bright, cheerful, and really well organized, which makes browsing a joy.

Highly recommend if you're looking for thoughtful gifts or fun toys that spark imagination. This place makes gift-giving easy and joyful!

featured_reviews.name: Jack Sparrow
featured_reviews.review_text:
I want to warn everyone about this fraud gift shop, which is nothing more than a scam disguised as an online store. My experience with them was one of the worst I’ve ever had. They show fancy photos, big promises, and claim to deliver beautiful gift hampers — but in reality, they cheat customers and deliver absolute garbage.

I ordered a customized gift box for a friend’s birthday after being impressed by the pictures and reviews on their site. Everything looked legitimate at first: they responded quickly before payment, assured on-time delivery, and promised high-quality products. But the moment I completed the payment, their tone completely changed. Messages were ignored, calls went unanswered, and updates stopped coming.

After waiting several days beyond the promised delivery date, I finally received a package — and it was shocking. The items were nothing like what was shown online. The chocolates were expired, the decorative box was broken, and the so-called “personalized items” were missing altogether. It looked like they had thrown random leftover things into a box just to mark the order as “delivered.”

When I tried to reach out to their support team, they either gave fake excuses or stopped responding completely. I was told “someone will call you back,” but no one ever did. Later, they even blocked my number and ignored my emails. This clearly shows that their operation is intentional fraud. There was no refund, no apology, and no responsibility taken for their actions.

Even the tracking number was fake. It kept showing “in transit” for a week, then suddenly marked as “delivered,” even though I hadn’t received anything at that point. They only sent a useless parcel after repeated complaints, most likely to close the order and avoid legal trouble.

What makes this worse is the way they manipulate photos and fake reviews to look genuine. Their entire business model seems to be based on deceiving people who want to send gifts to loved ones. They take advantage of emotions and trust, which makes this kind of fraud even more disgusting.

If you are thinking of buying anything from this store — don’t do it. They will take your money and deliver worthless junk or sometimes nothing at all. I lost my money, my time, and the surprise I planned for someone special.

This so-called gift shop is a complete fraud, and I strongly suggest reporting them to consumer authorities or payment gateways. They deserve to be banned from every online platform.

Please don’t fall for their fake photos, fake reviews, and false promises. Save your money and order from a genuine, verified seller instead. I’m sharing this review so that others don’t go through the same frustration, loss, and disappointment that I did.
